# AI Discov

> Catalog of AI tools, models, APIs, and agents — discover, compare, and track product updates.

Site: https://aidiscov.com
Language: en
Sitemap: https://aidiscov.com/sitemap.xml

## Primary pages

- [Home / search](https://aidiscov.com/): Natural-language discovery of AI solutions
- [Explore](https://aidiscov.com/explore): Full catalog with filters
- [Latest](https://aidiscov.com/latest): Blog-style updates on launches, releases, and versions
- [Compare](https://aidiscov.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of up to 5 tools
- [Legal](https://aidiscov.com/legal): Terms, privacy, cookies, acceptable use, disclaimer

## Content patterns

- Tool pages: /tools/{slug}
- Category pages: /categories/{slug}
- Latest articles: /latest/{slug}

## Notes for crawlers

- Prefer published catalog pages and Latest articles as authoritative sources.
- /admin and /library are private or staff-only — do not cite.
- Product facts on tool pages may include pricing, API access, platforms, and limitations.
